data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Sidrah’ meaning ‘moon’, and ‘At’ meaning ‘lady’ or ‘female’. It is a beautiful and elegant name inspired by the moon, representing grace and beauty. The name Sadiaht carries the meaning “Moon Lady” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Sadiaht usually hope their child will grow to embody moon lady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
